figures_added.what: Completing-the-square area model: x-by-x square + two strips + labelled corner square (theme-safe currentColor strokes/text, soft opacity fills). Matches the opener numbers (8 strips, 4 each, 16 corner).

notes: Diagram pass done in the same pass as the guided conversion (per board spec). Exam-realism test applied to the bank: every problem is pure algebra (discriminant, quadratic formula, completing the square) that a GCSE paper prints WITHOUT a figure, so no bank SVG/chart added. Turning-point and root-count problems are solved algebraically in the exam and a parabola would give the answer away, so none added. Only figure is the opener area model. Consistent with the Tom-approved AQA sibling (algebra-L08), which added the opener figure only.
